assistedPriceSafety.identity: Simplified product/title and URL identity; requestId, produtoId, requestedUrl, found title and proofVersion 3; no mandatory footer, technical sheet or selected-control query proof; explicit color/size/voltage contradiction still blocks
assistedPriceSafety.price: First eligible visible principal BRL price in page order, stable twice; exclude other sellers, installments, cashback, previous price, variation thumbnails and recommendations; JSON-LD is diagnostic only, never the source
assistedPriceSafety.writeGuard: Validate product/title, principal-price evidence, request identity and freshness before Firestore; large corrections are allowed without a percentage cap
assistedPriceSafety.rescan: Mobile option includes products already confirmed today without resetting database dates or re-reading cached catalogue
assistedPriceSafety.dataPreservation: Existing prices and history are not blindly reverted or deleted; repair each value only after checking the actual source

buyerExperienceAudit.priceHistoryIdentity: product article: current page ID; listing: own product link; never related product
buyerExperienceAudit.legacyRoutes: search-index.json redirects product to static page; category to published guide or directory section; no public Firestore reads
buyerExperienceAudit.adminSelection: union of public snapshot and already-loaded admin products, live fields win
buyerExperienceAudit.manufacturerCorrections: scripts/product-title-corrections.mjs; price, affiliate links, IDs and confirmation dates preserved
buyerExperienceAudit.methodology: category comparison, weekly ranking and editorial selection have distinct criteria

permanentBestChoices.migration: Seed selection once from six latest legacy promotions without mutating product data; persist public config until administrator saves
permanentBestChoices.publication: generate-best-choices.mjs runs after home/history generation and never queries Firestore
permanentBestChoices.price: Recent means confirmed within 24 hours; stale prices remain labeled as last recorded. Selection has no daily expiry
permanentBestChoices.seo: Permanent canonical CollectionPage plus categorized guide links and selected analyses. Mixed categories have no winner badges
permanentBestChoices.legacy: promotionSeoTitle and promotion fields preserved; old heading editor hidden

promotionTitle.aiSuggestions: Gemini with Google Search grounding over active promotions already loaded in the admin panel
promotionTitle.quotaFallback: Local suggestions match all six displayed offers and their real maximum price; mixed selection uses a neutral title; never saved automatically
promotionTitle.approval: Administrator selects, reviews and saves the title
promotionTitle.cacheSync: A successful administrative save refreshes the shared versioned 12-hour browser cache immediately; a new tools version invalidates the old cache and performs only one updated Firebase read

videoProductOverlay.desktop: Compact semitransparent button up to 320px wide

videoProductOverlay.accessibility: Dynamic aria-label identifies the corresponding product

marketplaceImageValidation.server: The resolver probes official mlstatic candidates, rejects processing placeholders and tries remaining pictures before returning a result
marketplaceImageValidation.mobile: The preview must finish a real browser image load before publication is allowed; a failed AI image is handed to the official resolver automatically
marketplaceImageValidation.failure: Keep product fields for review, show an explicit error and require a replacement image URL without writing Firestore

generatedContent.editorialNotes: scripts/published-editorial.mjs reads visible pros/cons independently of numeric Review JSON-LD; never invents ratings

externalStateNotStoredInRepository: App Check and reCAPTCHA Enterprise settings
Google Search Console ownership and reports
YouTube channel, Data API and OAuth client configuration
invariants: The latest GitHub main branch is the code source of truth
Never expose or commit secret values
Never delete catalog data because of a transient network or marketplace failure
Public search uses search-index.json instead of querying all Firestore products
Price availability checking runs as one manual daily batch unless force is explicit
The price batch uses the official items/bulk endpoint with at most 20 item IDs per request
The price batch reads Firestore once, reuses mercadolivre-status.json and mlb-resolucoes.json, and leaves deep item discovery to the locator workflow
The price batch uses at most two concurrent workers, spaces marketplace requests, retries 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff and jitter, and refreshes a rejected OAuth session at most once
Transient marketplace failures preserve the last confirmed price and never trigger individual sale-price or promotion requests for every product
top5-semanal.json contains exactly six distinct valid products despite its legacy filename
Weekly comparison contains exactly five comparable products and requires human approval
Shopee reuses the existing product record and does not duplicate catalog data
Generated pages, sitemap, analysis directory and search index must agree
Prices must never render as NaN
Ranki videos are kept in browser memory or YouTube, never Firebase Storage or Git
YouTube upload requires human approval and stores only the video reference on the product
The public video showcase accepts 3 to 20 YouTube and Ranking product URL pairs and never stores the video file in Firebase
The video administrator uses separate YouTube and Ranking product URL fields while preserving the existing site configuration document
Each public video has a clickable product card populated from search-index.json and synchronized with the current playlist item
The promotion title must be human-approved, descriptive and between 20 and 75 characters
AI promotion-title suggestions use only active offers already loaded by the dashboard and never trigger another full Firestore catalog read
Web-grounded title suggestions display their Google Search queries, sources and search widget and never claim popularity without evidence
AI promotion-title suggestions never save or publish automatically; a human must select, review and save the title
Architecture changes require updating both blueprint files
recoveryOrder: restore Git repository and main branch
restore GitHub Pages and custom domain
restore Firebase project, Firestore, Auth, rules, indexes and App Check
restore Mercado Livre application and GitHub secrets
restore DNS, Search Console and Analytics
test public, authenticated and mobile journeys

pausedConference.rule: Paused ads are excluded from daily queue and dashboard pending count. Review after 30 days is manual, never automatic deletion. Resume requires reconference.

publicIntegrity.offline: All HTML, scripts, JSON-LD and local references are validated during CI.
publicIntegrity.online: Manual workflow checks all public page/resource statuses and canonical consistency. Does not query Firestore, use credentials or test real purchases.
